name: bouncer/memory
description: Gives a model a memory that lasts between chats, using the official MCP memory server. The server is off until you turn it on.

skills.name: use-memory
skills.description: Stores and recalls facts about the user and their projects with the memory tools. Use when the user asks you to remember something or refers to something said earlier.
skills.instructions:
You have memory tools from the memory MCP server, if it is turned on.

- When the user asks you to remember something, save it as an entity with short observations.
- Before answering a question about the user or their projects, search the memory first.
- Tell the user what you saved. Do not save passwords, keys or other secrets.
- If the memory tools are not available, say that the memory server is off and where to turn it on: Settings › Plugins.

mcpServers.name: memory
mcpServers.description: Knowledge-graph memory from the official MCP servers (@modelcontextprotocol/server-memory, MIT). Needs Node.js.
